reason: The README clearly describes an AI SDK provider that orchestrates a DeepSeek Harness agent runtime, including streaming model calls, session continuity, and harness-managed shell and filesystem tools.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体运行时封装为 AI SDK LanguageModel，以支持文本生成、流式响应、会话管理及运行时工具调用。
summaries.en: Wraps the DeepSeek Harness agent runtime as an AI SDK LanguageModel for text generation, streaming responses, session management, and harness-managed tool execution.

capabilities: spawns and communicates with a DeepSeek Harness subprocess over stdio JSON-RPC
drives agent sessions through AI SDK generateText and streamText
enables harness-internal bash, file, subagent, and todo tools
persists and resumes multi-turn session context
uses API credentials and configurable environment, working directory, and runtime composition
